The '''liberation of Lorrd''' brought about the conclusion of the [[Kanz Disorders/Legends|Kanz Disorders]], and was led by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Mari-Elan Nora]]. In the aftermath of the battle, members of the [[Argazdan Redoubt]] retreated into the [[Slave Pits of Lorrd]].<ref name="Lord">''{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/feature20090531/index.html|text=Death in the Slave Pits of Lorrd}}''</ref>
